content: {"episode_id":"ep-05050","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope (R55) accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events. The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the monitoring service billed, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
